purpose: Hard pre-live gate registry for WF18 (Telegram gateway). While any P0/P1 item is unresolved, tools/wf18_activation_gate.js REFUSES to let deploy publish/activate WF18. DEC-161 resolved the rearchitecture blockers with named regression tests (mostly tests/test_wf18_real_topology.js). TELEGRAM-001 (public HTTPS ingress) is intentionally LEFT OPEN — it is operator infrastructure (sing-box / port 443), not a repository change — so the gate correctly stays CLOSED until the operator provisions ingress. Code is dispatcher-ready; it is not yet live-ready.

cleared_statuses.resolved: fully fixed in code; clears the gate ONLY with non-empty evidence (real code + a named regression test).
cleared_statuses.accepted: a residual risk explicitly accepted by the operator; clears the gate ONLY with evidence + residual_risk + accepted_by.
cleared_statuses._blocking: every other status (mitigated, partial, open, unresolved, …) BLOCKS WF18 activation.

n8n_concurrency_capability: n8n 2.23.3 OSS exposes a GLOBAL production concurrency limit (N8N_CONCURRENCY_PRODUCTION_LIMIT) only — there is no per-workflow concurrency=1 in regular mode (queue mode offers per-worker concurrency). True per-WF18 single-concurrency therefore requires queue-mode worker isolation OR an atomic idempotency claim store; a Google Sheets read-then-write is NOT atomic.

blockers.title: nested payload passed to autoMapInputData (no shaping nodes)
read-then-write dedupe race
blockers.evidence: PROVEN (static/offline): deterministic updateIdempotencyKey + claim-before-any-side-effect ordering (IDEMP-002) + the duplicate branch reaching ZERO Sheets writes / ZERO child calls / ZERO business sends — tests/test_wf18_real_topology.js §19.5 and §19.3-5. This eliminates the SEQUENTIAL duplicate race only.
blockers.residual_risk: CONCURRENT exactly-once is NOT guaranteed: the idempotency claim is a Google Sheets read-then-write (not atomic) and n8n 2.23.3 OSS has no per-workflow concurrency=1 — see n8n_concurrency_capability. Two truly-simultaneous deliveries of the same update_id could both pass the claim. In practice one bot has one webhook and Telegram spaces its retries, so the window is small but real.
blockers.mitigation_options: (a) implement an atomic claim store (DB/KV conditional insert) for the idempotency key, OR (b) run n8n in queue mode with WF18 isolated to a single-concurrency worker, OR (c) operator explicitly accepts the residual risk (set status=accepted with accepted_by + residual_risk).
blockers.gate_effect: status=mitigated BLOCKS WF18 activation. Flip to resolved only with an atomic store + a concurrency regression test, or to accepted with explicit operator sign-off.
